title: Multi-Tenant Microservice Sandbox Execution via isolated-vm
summary: ChatbotX architectural pattern isolating user-authored dynamic JavaScript flow step logic inside a decoupled HTTP microservice (apps/javascript-executor) utilizing isolated-vm for V8 heap boundary confinement, CPU execution bounds, and memory isolation.

references.description: Microservice HTTP entrypoint executing isolated V8 contexts
Client SDK and contract types for communicating with the executor

claims.claim: Flow script execution is offloaded from main Next.js and BullMQ processes into a standalone microservice using isolated-vm to prevent prototype pollution and CPU thread locking.
Client communication with the sandbox enforces strict timeout budgets, payload size limits, and sanitized global variable injection.
